subject: POS Terminal T1 intermittent network connectivity issues
description: The POS terminal at counter 1 (POS-0029-T1) is experiencing intermittent network disconnections throughout the day, causing transaction delays and customer checkout delays. The terminal connects and drops connection every 5-10 minutes, affecting order processing efficiency. The issue started this morning around 14:30 IST. Terminal has been restarted once by staff but the problem persists.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and logged. Confirmed with store manager that terminal T1 has unstable network connection. Advised to check ethernet cable connection and restart device.
